metamorphic_relations.name: T-pose or default rig pose
metamorphic_relations.check: Is any character frozen in a T-pose, A-pose, or other stiff default pose while gameplay continues around them?

metamorphic_relations.name: Wrong or stuck animation state
metamorphic_relations.check: Is a character locked in a pose (seated, falling, aiming) that does not match their current movement or context?

metamorphic_relations.name: Floating or stuck mid-air
metamorphic_relations.check: Is any character suspended in mid-air with no visible ground, platform, rope, or vehicle supporting them?

metamorphic_relations.name: Walking on water or non-solid surface
metamorphic_relations.check: Is a character walking or standing on water, smoke, or another clearly non-solid surface as if it were ground?

metamorphic_relations.name: Clipping through solid geometry
metamorphic_relations.check: Are any body parts or characters visibly passing through walls, floors, doors, rocks, or other solid objects?

metamorphic_relations.name: Missing or distorted body parts
metamorphic_relations.check: Is a character missing a head, limb, or other major body part, or are limbs stretched/deformed abnormally?

metamorphic_relations.name: Overpowered ragdoll or launch
metamorphic_relations.check: Is a character launched unrealistically far or fast from a minor impact (e.g., shot once but flies into the sky)?

metamorphic_relations.name: Characters occupying same space
metamorphic_relations.check: Are two characters visibly merged or overlapping inside each other's bodies?

metamorphic_relations.name: Projectiles frozen in air
metamorphic_relations.check: Are arrows, bullets, or other projectiles hanging motionless in mid-air without hitting anything?

metamorphic_relations.name: Projectiles passing through targets
metamorphic_relations.check: Do visible projectiles pass through characters or objects without any hit reaction or damage?

metamorphic_relations.name: Vehicle floating or flying
metamorphic_relations.check: Is a ground vehicle (car, boat) suspended in mid-air or moving through the sky with no support?

metamorphic_relations.name: Unstable vehicle buoyancy
metamorphic_relations.check: Does a boat jerk, bounce, or sink wildly when a character steps on it?

metamorphic_relations.name: Vehicle animation mismatch
metamorphic_relations.check: Are wheels spinning while the vehicle is stationary, or is the vehicle moving with frozen wheels/rotors?

metamorphic_relations.name: Character on vehicle without support
metamorphic_relations.check: Is a character standing or hanging on a moving vehicle with no visible rope, harness, or grab point?

metamorphic_relations.name: Invisible objects being interacted with
metamorphic_relations.check: Are characters interacting with (opening, carrying, sitting in) objects that are completely invisible?

metamorphic_relations.name: Non-reactive environment
metamorphic_relations.check: Does grass, foliage, or other dynamic scenery stay completely rigid when a character moves through it?

metamorphic_relations.name: Objects vibrating or jittering
metamorphic_relations.check: Are objects or characters rapidly jittering, shaking, or oscillating in place without cause?

metamorphic_relations.name: Camera inside geometry
metamorphic_relations.check: Is the camera stuck inside a wall, character head, or object, filling the screen with close-up textures?

metamorphic_relations.name: Severe lighting or shadow glitch
metamorphic_relations.check: Is the scene flickering, or are shadows pointing in impossible directions or appearing/disappearing abruptly?

metamorphic_relations.name: UI state inconsistent with world
metamorphic_relations.check: Do quest markers, objectives, or HUD elements contradict what is clearly visible in the game world?

metamorphic_relations.name: Invisible wall or barrier
metamorphic_relations.check: Is a character blocked by nothing visible in an area that looks completely open and traversable?

metamorphic_relations.name: Falling through floor or map
metamorphic_relations.check: Does a character suddenly drop through solid ground into empty space or under the map?

metamorphic_relations.name: Vehicle passing through solid objects
metamorphic_relations.check: Does a vehicle drive through a wall, tree, or other car without any collision reaction?

metamorphic_relations.name: Duplicating or multiplying objects
metamorphic_relations.check: Do items duplicate or respawn immediately in the same spot when picked up or interacted with?

metamorphic_relations.name: Missing or mismatched sounds
metamorphic_relations.check: Are major visible events (gunshots, explosions, crashes) completely silent, or do sounds play for non-existent events?

metamorphic_relations.name: Abrupt teleportation
metamorphic_relations.check: Does a character or object jump to a completely different position between frames with no transition or effect?

metamorphic_relations.name: Dead character acting alive
metamorphic_relations.check: Does a character in a death or ragdoll state continue to aim, talk, or react as if alive?

metamorphic_relations.name: Ghost UI elements
metamorphic_relations.check: Do interaction prompts or HUD elements remain on screen after the relevant object or context is gone?

metamorphic_relations.name: Incorrect transparency or ghosting
metamorphic_relations.check: Are normally solid characters or objects appearing semi-transparent or leaving persistent afterimages?

metamorphic_relations.name: Broken water interaction
metamorphic_relations.check: Is a character running underwater at normal speed, or are objects ignoring buoyancy entirely?

metamorphic_relations.name: Weapon misalignment
metamorphic_relations.check: Is a held weapon floating away from the hand, clipping through the body, or visibly misattached?

metamorphic_relations.name: Motion defying gravity or inertia
metamorphic_relations.check: Does a large object (car, character, prop) instantly stop, reverse, or accelerate with no physical cause?
